meta.units: AU, ecliptic J2000, flat [x,y,z,...] x 60 points
meta.helio_orbit: heliocentric, 60 points over one full orbital period starting at start_jd
meta.geo_window: geocentric (asteroid minus Earth), 60 points evenly over the 10-year window
meta.geo_approach: geocentric, 60 points over +-60 days around closest approach (clipped to window)
meta.earth_orbit: heliocentric Earth, 60 points over one year from start_jd
meta.selection: all impact-category objects by ascending min_dist, then closest others; 300 total
